mistakes: This package imports no runtime and no engine. Pass any `ChatEngine` from `@hackbuild/chat` as `engine`, or `scripted()` from there when you want no model; never import a runtime here.
`now` is required. Pass a clock such as `() => Date.now()`, or a fake clock in tests.
With a `sink`, call `await conv.restore()` before the first `send`. Nothing is saved until `restore()` resolves, so a page that skips it never writes its session.

`send` stops the reply that is still streaming before it adds the new turn, and resolves with `null` when the reply was empty or aborted before a word. Check for `null` instead of reading `reply.content`.
The `greeting` is shown first and never sent to the engine. Put instructions in `system`, and read what the next reply would send with `conv.request()`.
`importSession` throws `SessionError` for a file that is not JSON, has no messages list, or carries a newer version. Catch it and show its message instead of loading a broken session.
